_comment: Resource budgets for the Hypothalamus. VRAM total is the cap on model allocations; the headroom is never allocated to models, keeping the OS compositor and desktop responsive. MAX_VRAM_MB and MAX_AGENT_RAM_MB are also read from .env, with these config values as defaults.

_modes.idle: No user input for 5 minutes - reduce background jobs
_modes.performance: Heavy task - unload idle models for speed
